export: Unstepped initial states only. Values read from actual Rapier bodies/colliders, with no future states or experimental outcomes.
reference_fact: REF is the original nine-stage configuration, known to complete all nine stages within 30 simulated seconds.
coordinates: right-handed; +Y is up; lengths in scene units; time in seconds; quaternions [x,y,z,w]
start_action: Only ball changes from fixed to dynamic. All initial velocities are zero. All other bodies and joints are already dynamic/fixed as specified. No further applied impulses, motors or timed triggers.

observer.definition: Flags record the first physical state/contact satisfying each condition; they do not control or move bodies.
stages: At least 6 remaining domino bodies have abs(worldQuaternion.z)>0.30
A ball-gate collision has occurred AND abs(gate.worldQuaternion.z)>0.1
A ball-wheel collision has occurred AND wheel.angularVelocity.z^2>0.04
A ball-lever collision has occurred AND abs(lever.angularVelocity.z)>0.04
A ball-bucket collision has occurred AND abs(bucket.worldQuaternion.x)>0.12
A ball-hammer collision has occurred AND abs(hammer.angularVelocity.z)>0.1
observer.contact_definition: Each contact key is true if a ball-versus-that-body collision-start event occurs during the 30s run. barrier refers to the obstacle. Bell completion specifically requires hammer-bell contact, not ball-bell proximity.
